title: LiquidM Visual Report
description: Response of GET /visual_reports.json on the LiquidM Reporting API. Derived from openapi/liquid-m-reporting-openapi.yml, which was generated from LiquidM's published Reporting API README.

dimensions.description: The dimensions list used for this report.

columns.description: The reported columns, each with an id and a name.

rows.description: One flat row list. Never nested, even when dimensions are specified.

id.description: Column identifier, matching a dimension or metric id.

name.description: Human-readable column name as shown in Visual Reports.

ReportRow.description: Map of column id to a cell.

value.description: Internal representation of the value. May change unit representation over time.

name.description: Present instead of formatted_value when the cell is an entity.
